body: 2026-06-14: Relocated from khanakia_com/filemark/apps/web/ → filemark/apps/website/. Reasons: (1) /demo can import {MDXViewer} from '@filemark/mdx' directly via pnpm workspace link — no version bumps / no publishing dance / HMR works; (2) no separate GitHub repo to manage (filemark monorepo already public); (3) ships alongside the renderer it advertises (always in lockstep); (4) matches apps/{chrome-ext,playground,desktop,website} convention. Package renamed @khanakia/filemark-web → @filemark/website. tsconfig extends ../../tsconfig.base.json. Inside-monorepo cost: must remember to 'task build:packages' before website build/dev since @filemark/mdx is consumed from dist/. Old khanakia_com/filemark/ directory removed.
title: Filemark website lives at apps/website inside the filemark monorepo, not a sibling repo
